description.zh-CN: 按账号整理 GitHub 仓库、Issue 与 PR 分拣进度、跟进日期和本地评审草稿。
description.zh-TW: 依帳號整理 GitHub 倉庫、Issue 與 PR 分揀進度、追蹤日期與本機評審草稿。
description.en: Organize GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, follow-ups and local review drafts by account.
description.ja: GitHub のリポジトリ、Issue、プルリクエスト、フォローアップ、ローカルレビュー下書きをアカウント別に整理します。
description.ko: GitHub 저장소, 이슈, 풀 리퀘스트, 후속 항목, 로컬 리뷰 초안을 계정별로 정리합니다.
description.es: Organiza por cuenta los repositorios, issues, pull requests, seguimientos y borradores locales de revisión de GitHub.
description.de: Organisiert GitHub-Repositories, Issues, Pull Requests, Follow-ups und lokale Review-Entwürfe nach Konto.
description.fr: Organiser les dépôts GitHub, issues, pull requests, suivis et brouillons de revue locaux par compte.

import extra from "./locales.json" with { type: "json" };
export type WidgetLocale = "en" | "zh-CN" | "zh-TW" | "ja" | "ko" | "es" | "de" | "fr";
export function normalizeLocale(raw?: string): WidgetLocale {
  const locale = (raw || "en").toLowerCase();
  if (/^zh-(tw|hk|mo|hant)(-|$)/.test(locale)) return "zh-TW";
  if (locale === "zh" || locale.startsWith("zh-")) return "zh-CN";
  const language = locale.split("-")[0];
  return language === "ja" || language === "ko" || language === "es" || language === "de" || language === "fr" ? language : "en";
}

export type MessageKey = Key;

export function t(key: Key): string {
  const loc = pudding.locale.read();
  const table = messages[normalizeLocale(loc)];
  return table[key] ?? en[key];
}

export function errorText(error: unknown): string {
  const s = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
  return s in en
    ? t(s as Key)
    : s.includes("widget_data_conflict")
      ? t("conflict")
      : s;
}
